step1_analysis.circuit_type: Bias Decoupling Network / RC Low-Pass Filter
step1_analysis.description: This is a passive RC low-pass filter sub-block used in the traveling-wave amplifier (TWA). It is typically used to apply a DC bias voltage to a transistor gate (like a cascode gate, Vg2) while decoupling and isolating the RF signal from the DC bias supply.

paper_reference.title: 60-GHz SOI CMOS Traveling-Wave Amplifier With NF Below 3.8 dB From 0.1 to 40 GHz

f_3db.description: -3dB cutoff frequency of the RC filter

sky130_expected.calculation: 1 / (2 * pi * R * C) with assumed R=1kΩ, C=1pF
sky130_expected.reasoning: The cutoff frequency must be well below the operating frequency (40-60 GHz) to effectively block RF leakage into the bias network.
High isolation is required at the TWA's maximum operating frequency to prevent RF power loss.

twa_gain.description: Gain of the full Traveling-Wave Amplifier (Note: Cannot be measured on this passive sub-block)

sky130_expected.reasoning: This metric applies to the full TWA circuit described in the paper. The provided netlist is only a passive RC bias sub-block.

twa_nf.description: Noise Figure of the full TWA (Note: Cannot be measured on this passive sub-block)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Applies to the full TWA. The RC network's noise contribution is minimal if properly decoupled.

twa_bandwidth.description: Operating bandwidth of the full TWA (Note: Cannot be measured on this passive sub-block)

step3_testbench.description: Measures the AC frequency response, -3dB cutoff frequency, and RF isolation at 40 GHz of the bias decoupling network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Decoupling Network Testbench

.param Rbias=1k
.param CRF_shunt2=1p

* DUT
Rbias Vg2 N1 {Rbias}
CRF_shunt2 N1 GND {CRF_shunt2}

* Stimulus (Applying AC signal at the RF side to measure isolation at the bias side)
Vin Vg2 GND dc 1.0 ac 1.0

.control
* AC Analysis to measure filter characteristics
ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
let gain_db = vdb(N1)

* Measure -3dB cutoff frequency
meas ac f_3db when gain_db=-3 fall=1

* Measure attenuation at 40 GHz
meas ac atten_40G find gain_db at=40G

* DC Operating Point
op
print v(N1)

quit
.endc
.end
